decision_meanings.keep_for_review: Bounded task can move to human/domain review before any agent run.
decision_meanings.revise_before_run: Task idea remains useful but prompt, metric, action boundary, or logs need revision.
decision_meanings.reject_as_overclaim: Task would reward source-layer promotion, model-result overclaiming, or result language.
decision_meanings.blocked_missing_authority: Task cannot proceed until source, rights, cultural authority, or reviewer approval exists.

forbidden_decision_effects: do not approve an agent run
do not create paper or release readiness
do not promote derived counts into source-observed claims
